name: One Voice
description: The class counts to a target number together. Anyone may say the next number at any moment — but if two people jump in at almost the same time, the count resets and everyone groans and laughs. No turn order, no strategy talk, no winner: the class makes it together or tries again. Each number is spoken aloud through the teacher's speakers. Good for laughter, togetherness, and a little wonder.
tagline: Perfect for the five minutes after a test, a rainy-day reset, or any moment the room needs to breathe together.

target.label: Count to
target.helper: 20 is the classic. Higher is much harder.

collisionWindow.label: Strictness (milliseconds)
collisionWindow.helper: Two taps closer together than this count as 'two voices at once'. 400 is a good start; lower is more forgiving.

maxAttempts.label: Attempt cap (optional)
maxAttempts.helper: End after this many attempts with the story so far. Leave empty for unlimited — you can always move on manually.

template.name: One Voice
template.description: Count to the target together — two voices at once and it's back to one.

rules.message:
We're going to count to ${target} — together, as one voice.

Anyone can tap the next number, anytime. But if two people tap at almost the same moment, we start over from zero.

The rules: no pointing at who should go next, no turn order, no talking strategy. Just feel the room.

story.template:
Our story:

We counted to {{count.target}} as one voice.
It took us {{count.attempts}} attempt(s) and {{count.resets}} restart(s).
Our longest run along the way: {{count.bestRun}}.

Nobody won. Everybody did.
